name: host-build-heap-fits-the-rehearsal-container
reason: MEASURED (beta-118, beta-119): the upstream host-build heap ceiling is larger than any container this rehearsal may start, so V8 does not collect hard enough and the build is OOM-killed with 137 -- a CODE red no source change could fix. At --memory 3700m with heap 3072 the build COMPLETES, peak 3515 MiB of 3700 (a 95% fit, named in rehearsal-meeting section 16). INERT ON GITHUB'S 7 GB RUNNER: it changes how the compiler runs, never what it emits.
